sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently topping the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture in excellent form, having won their last game and recorded five wins in their last six matches (W-D-W-W-W). Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six outings, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second in the table and five games played fewer than the leaders, travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between two mid-table sides. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth place; Bridgnorth have won their last game after a loss, while Eccleshall are looking to bounce back after losing their most recent match. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community in a fixture between sides separated by six points. Bilston Town's home match against Foley Meir features a team in strong recent form (W-W-D-W-W) facing opponents also on a positive run (W-D-W-L-D-W). Shawbury United, struggling with five losses in their last six games, host Barnton, who have been more steady with three draws and a win in recent fixtures. Market Drayton Town, winless in their last two, travel to face New Mills, another team in poor form with losses in two of their last three. Brereton Social, on mixed form with a win but also losses in recent games, host Widnes Town, who remain pointless at the foot of the table with just two draws from seven games. Cheadle Heath Nomads, drawing their last game, visit Telford Town, who are also struggling near the bottom; both sides have won only once in 10 or fewer games. Finally, Crewe, in a poor run with losses in four of their last six, travel to face Allscott Heath, who have shown some improvement with back-to-back wins.
